name: Farliauzco
backstory: Child of Forliauzco and Farliazco; raised in Terfila on unloads crates at the market stalls through the..., and carries some knowledge of Birth Of Dornarius.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Had a child with Tamuken, named Forliuken.
Grew up hearing: Had a child with Forliukar, named Farliukar.
Heard that Forliauzco and Forliamuk now have a child, Forliauken.
Heard that Forliauzco and Farliazco now have a child, Forliuzazco.
Heard that Tamuzco and Farliazco now have a child, Farliuzco.
Heard that Forliamuk and Tamuzco now have a child, Tamuzmuken.
Heard that Tamuzaken and Farliukar now have a child, Tamuzukar.
Had a child with Tamuzarlo, named Farliauzar.
Heard that Forliauzco and Farliazco now have a child, Farliazuzco.
Heard that Forliauken and Farliukar now have a child, Forliaukarla.
Heard that Forliauzco and Farliukar now have a child, Forliaukarli.
Had a child with Tamuzarlo, named Tamuzauzco.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only by making Death Of Forliarlo their own concern
criterion.wasted_life: treating Death Of Forliarlo as someone else's concern
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: works the morning tide unloading crates at the stalls, swapping gossip for cheap drink, and picking up the knack of telling the tollhouse story differently to whoever's listening.
